name: Vuonatjviken-Jäckvik
description: Vuonatjviken to Jäckvik. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
utilities: ICA Nära Jäckvik / Handlar'n i Jäckvik (food)
Riebnes east landing / Vuonatjviken boat start (transit)
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Route geometry is multipart planning linework around Riebnes and Kapellströmmarna. This section needs booked Riebnes boat transport and a short rowboat crossing before Jäckvik.

STF/Naturkartan display 5.4 km Riebnes boat plus 18 km hiking, while WFS composed geometry is about 23.744 km before small gaps, OSM/Waymarked totals about 24.252 km, and route apps/tracks show 24.1-26.6 km. Likely cause: official distance separates hiking from boat, while mapped routes include boats and endpoint variants.
STF says 400 m; Naturkartan/Båttrafik say 300 m; OSM measures about 316 m; WFS rowboat object measures about 251 m and is laterally offset from the connected walking break.

STF/Naturkartan/Länsstyrelsen mostly use Jäckvik for trail stage; Lantmäteriet settlement and Kyrkans Fjällgård use Jäkkvik; ASCII slugs use Jackvik/Jakkvik. WFS, OSM and Naturkartan endpoints differ by hundreds of meters.
Official STF points to current private boat contacts and advance booking. Field reports vary from older 250-350 SEK / 10:00-18:00 style times to 2024-2025 reports of 440 SEK and 09:00 in late season.
Hornavan-Sädvajaure is clearly relevant to the Jäckvik/Riebnes area and Pieljekaise begins at/after Jäckvik, but no full selected-line overlay was performed.

Kyrkans Fjällgård and ICA Jäckvik are strong. Riebnes/Kapellströmmarna connectors are strong as access metadata. Several OSM-only camp/fire/shelter/toilet/bridge records lack current/official confirmation.

Official ICA page lists grocery opening daily 09-20 and services including pharmacy agent, fuel/tank station, gasol, cafe, bus goods, parcel agents, AED, charging, pant station, wifi, fishing permits and Systembolaget agent. Public commercial service but hours are date-sensitive. Fold fuel/gasol/cafe/pharmacy-agent/parcel/charging/AED/pant into service metadata unless taxonomy requires child records.

facilities.name: Kapellströmmarna rowboat crossing
facilities.coordinateSource: Midpoint of connected WFS/OSM walking break landings; WFS rowboat OBJECTID 11222151 is offset west and should be treated as conflicting official connector geometry.

Official guidance says one boat must remain on each side, so rowing three times may be necessary. Model as rowboat connector with two landings; preserve length conflict and WFS offset caveat.
